title: Trump Media’s bitcoin holdings shrink as crypto losses hit $361 million
summary: The Truth Social parent held 9,477 BTC worth $557 million at the end of June, while its Cronos position also suffered a steep drop in value.

title: Bitwise's Rasmussen: Circle is mispriced as stablecoins head toward trillions
summary: Bitwise's Ryan Rasmussen says investors are underestimating Circle as stablecoins expand and the company builds out its payments infrastructure.

title: Strategy builds $4.75 billion cash cushion as only bitcoin isn’t enough for investors
summary: Strategy is holding billions in cash after learning that traditional investors don’t necessarily view its massive bitcoin reserves as a substitute for dollars.

title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
summary: The asset manager said it no longer intends to proceed with the offerings. None became effective, and no securities were issued or sold.

title: Solana lending giant Jupiter now lets the same dollar earn twice
summary: The new Lend v2 product turns deposits and borrowed assets into trading liquidity, tying higher returns to whether Jupiter’s router can send enough swap flow to the new vaults.
